nodes.rationale: view=finance owns agreements, supervision and contractor income independently of task stages, CRM budget and lifecycle. Private notes do not enter activity.
nodes.norm_label: project finance independent of production lifecycle
nodes.community_name: Project Finance independent of production lifecycle

nodes.label: Project Finance SQL security and history contracts
nodes.rationale: Covers flexible schedules, immutable amendments, partial settlements, forecast/due separation, monthly uniqueness, visit billing, contractor ownership and archived project collection.
nodes.norm_label: project finance sql security and history contracts

nodes.label: Actionable advance, overpayment and private access tests
nodes.rationale: Covers standalone income/utilities exclusion, explicit incoming/outgoing advance inclusion, historical matching and contextual overpayment inclusion, and employee/foreign-studio denial.
nodes.norm_label: actionable advance, overpayment and private access tests

nodes.label: Advances and unresolved credits
nodes.rationale: Money explicitly recorded for later matching, plus remaining or released amounts from prior matches. Ordinary completed transactions are not shown here.

nodes.rationale: Кошти, явно залишені для подальшого пов’язування, а також залишки чи вивільнені суми попередніх погашень. Звичайні завершені операції тут не показуються.

nodes.label: Залишити як аванс для подальшого пов’язування
nodes.rationale: Для переплат клієнтів або передоплат студії, які пізніше погасять очікуваний платіж.

nodes.label: Stored events and live Calendar projections
nodes.rationale: Only real events use calendar_events; project/task deadlines, CRM follow-ups, time off, payroll and people/studio dates retain canonical sources.
nodes.norm_label: stored events and live calendar projections

nodes.label: Calendar semantic events
nodes.rationale: Event types define organizer, invitee, assignee and participant roles. Completed projects allow follow-up events; archived projects do not. Recurrence retains root and occurrence identity.

nodes.label: Payroll reminders
nodes.rationale: Created Finance payout and bonus obligations provide admin-only amount-free reminders; expected timing can change without changing source identity or implying payment. Membership dates never produce pay schedules.

nodes.label: Calendar relevance predicate
nodes.rationale: isCalendarEventRelevantToUser governs mine and Google projection by semantic event role; broader RLS visibility is not synchronization relevance.

nodes.label: Time-off privacy
nodes.rationale: Requester and admins see private requests, only admins see review notes; coworkers get approved intervals and generic availability through privacy-safe RPC.

nodes.label: Work-makeup compensation relationship
nodes.rationale: Work-makeup events retain a link to approved day-off requests.

nodes.label: One-way Google Calendar projection
nodes.rationale: Each user has a dedicated secondary calendar and deterministic source mappings. Transactional coalesced root-event outbox and bounded scheduled retries preserve durable delivery; synthetic items are excluded.

nodes.label: Calendar URL and snapshot ownership
nodes.rationale: Date/view load server ranges; source/person/project/mine filters use local history. Same-range snapshots replace collection while preserving later mutations and open drafts.

nodes.label: Canonical task milestone projection
nodes.rationale: Lightweight paginated range candidates retain complete deadlines; next-unreached selector determines bounded full-detail reads even when local task filter is hidden.

nodes.label: Team lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Administrators invite employees without project memberships. Removal, impact and reassignment are atomic durable lifecycle operations; descriptive job title grants no access.

nodes.label: Administration queue
nodes.rationale: Time-off review shares Calendar backend. Dashboard receives a separate capped count and upcoming absences without private review details.

nodes.label: Contractor directory
nodes.rationale: Active members may create/edit; only admins delete or administer categories. Tenant ownership flows through category; Finance references restrict deletion.

nodes.label: CRM Leads
nodes.rationale: Admin-only studio-scoped leads retain structured project metadata, budget currency, contact dates and lifecycle history. Eligible lead-to-project conversion atomically creates project, marks Won and links history.

nodes.label: CRM Lead follow-ups
nodes.rationale: Canonical timestamps drive admin Calendar projection, unread reminders and persistent overdue state. Reading notifications does not resolve follow-up; invalid leads have none.

nodes.label: Candidate recruiting cycles
nodes.rationale: Separate candidate identity and hiring-attempt history; at most one unfinished cycle. Guarded saves are atomic and candidate-to-member conversion is manual.

nodes.label: Office workspace
nodes.rationale: Canonical submissions and standalone assignments use URL-addressable local overlays, authoritative server-action revalidation and lightweight overview summaries.

nodes.label: Submission workflow
nodes.rationale: Requests need a fixed category and active responsible member; guarded manage_submission atomically assigns/transitions. Anonymous complaints retain no author; private admin details stay separate.

nodes.label: Office assignments
nodes.rationale: Admins create/manage/cancel; assigned active member may advance assigned to in_progress to done. No project progress or productivity relationship exists.

nodes.label: Workstations
nodes.rationale: Studio-owned Office/Remote positions have unique positive numbers and at most one current assignment per member. Atomic bulk creation preserves uniqueness.

nodes.label: Equipment inventory
nodes.rationale: Stable independent equipment identity allows nullable workstation reassignment; retired records and reserved inventory codes remain. Admin-only grants/RLS protect typed configuration and lifecycle.

nodes.label: Equipment maintenance history
nodes.rationale: Atomic RPCs coordinate a single open service event and in_service lifecycle. Completion advances recurring due dates from actual completion; disabling schedules preserves append-oriented history.

nodes.label: Office floor plan placements
nodes.rationale: Admin atomic snapshot RPC stores normalized placements independent of inventory and repository SVGs; removing placement does not alter physical asset records.

nodes.label: Team payroll lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Member removal and profile deactivation stop future payroll from next service month while existing and earned obligations survive; restoration never restarts compensation.

nodes.label: Recipient-private operational notifications
nodes.rationale: Private database producers persist localized semantic metadata, skip actors/inactive recipients, and permit recipients to change only read_at. Realtime toasts do not mark read; equipment cron deduplicates reminders.

nodes.label: Canonical active-studio membership resolver
nodes.rationale: Exactly one active membership is accepted; unauthenticated, no-studio and multiple-studio outcomes are explicit.

nodes.label: Legacy profile role mirror
nodes.rationale: Membership is canonical authority; do not add authorization dependencies on descriptive metadata or the legacy profile mirror.

nodes.label: RLS and grants security boundary
nodes.rationale: UI visibility and server checks provide feedback and defense, while grants and RLS authorize access.

nodes.label: Atomic membership removal and restoration
nodes.rationale: Removal preserves history and coordinates reassignment/deactivation; restoration does not recreate project memberships.

nodes.label: Finance administrator-only access
nodes.rationale: Active profile and active studio admin membership are required for ledger, planning, snapshots, payroll and project Finance, including archived projects; employees receive no access.

nodes.label: Historical opening persistence
nodes.rationale: value_finance_opening writes cutover valuation metadata on accounts under the Finance admin and parent-lock boundary. Triggers invalidate stale drafts, require complete foreign valuations at new finalization and freeze finalized valuations; legacy missing values can be completed once without creating ledger rows.

nodes.label: Ordered migration authority
nodes.rationale: Ordered imperative migrations and focused database tests define intended behavior, not remote deployment state; there is no declarative schema source.

nodes.label: Generated schema types
nodes.rationale: TypeScript database types are generated from the updated local database and are never hand-edited.

nodes.label: RLS and explicit grants
nodes.rationale: Grants permit operation categories and policies constrain eligible tenant rows; all browser-reachable tables require both.

nodes.label: Atomic guarded RPCs
nodes.rationale: Public RPCs own transitions that require atomic multi-row writes and verified identity; clients must not reproduce partial workflow logic.

nodes.label: Restricted private helpers
nodes.rationale: Private helpers implement predicates, triggers and lookups with execution revoked unless explicitly exposed.

nodes.label: Security-definer boundary
nodes.rationale: Empty search paths, schema-qualified objects, internal auth and membership checks, and minimum execution grants protect privileged functions.

nodes.label: Database invariants
nodes.rationale: Constraints and triggers enforce immutable identity, lifecycle transitions, snapshot accounting, notification shape and tenant-safe references.

nodes.label: Local migration workflow
nodes.rationale: Inspect the full applicable migration chain, append a new migration, validate locally and regenerate types; remote mutation requires explicit confirmation.

nodes.label: Separate Supabase clients
nodes.rationale: Browser caller-context, cookie-aware server and privileged server-only clients remain separate; privileged clients never enter Client Components.

nodes.label: Legacy compatibility boundaries
nodes.rationale: Legacy area progress and due dates remain schema compatibility surfaces; mock helpers must never authorize authenticated product access.

nodes.label: Shared equipment catalog
nodes.rationale: Shared models and provider products are admin-readable and worker-managed; service-only sync coordinates idempotent imports and catalog deletion is ungranted.

nodes.label: Finance schedule persistence
nodes.rationale: Immutable effective-dated terms and stable employee/service-period obligation identities map to existing expected items; lifecycle triggers preserve history.

nodes.label: Finance cash planning persistence
nodes.rationale: Immutable budget revisions and forecast snapshots retain plans and assumptions without duplicating the actual ledger; strict Finance admin RLS and guarded writes apply.

nodes.label: Finance Overview projection
nodes.rationale: get_finance_overview is an admin-only caller-context projection over canonical forecast and ledger/expected views; it adds no tables or financial sources.

nodes.label: Business trips
nodes.rationale: Immutable receipts preserve historical actual valuation and canonical ledger/settlement links. Plans use current FX assumptions independently of immutable original currencies; advances and reimbursements do not duplicate costs. Calendar owns linked operational metadata while Finance owns status and money. Multi-traveler per diem keeps immutable coverage. Stable traveler/currency balances defer unused-advance returns until completion or cancellation.

nodes.label: reconcile_finance_trip
nodes.rationale: Refund reversal restores cash availability without restoring allocations, so reconciliation explicitly rematches restored trip cash to prevent unrelated reuse.

nodes.label: reconcile_finance_trip
nodes.rationale: Unspent advances become expected incoming returns only when a trip is completed or cancelled; active and planned trips retain unused advance balances without premature receivables.

nodes.label: save_finance_trip
nodes.rationale: Saving trip status calls reconciliation atomically so completion or cancellation confirms unused advance returns.

nodes.label: record_finance_trip_entry
nodes.rationale: Qualifying finance_trip_entries.kind separates stored plan selection from requested entry kind. Paid plans convert only using their exact whole payment; release, replacement and rematching remain atomic.

nodes.label: trip_category
nodes.rationale: Reuse the existing business_travel default category, preferring it over a matching custom outgoing operating Business travel category. Match custom names after trimming and lowercasing, preserve their historical names, and create a category only if none matches. Incoming returns continue using other_income.

nodes.label: StudioFlow: Next.js and Supabase system
nodes.rationale: Single-studio runtime access requires one active Profile and exactly one active studio membership.

nodes.label: Verified request flow through Data API or narrow RPC
nodes.rationale: Browser requests reach App Router server boundaries, typed validation and verified actor lookup, then Data API/RPC and database grants, RLS, constraints, and triggers.
nodes.norm_label: verified request flow through data api or narrow rpc

nodes.label: Server Component reads and interactive mutation boundaries
nodes.rationale: Prefer Server Components with server-only queries and cookie-aware Supabase clients; use Client Components for browser APIs, hooks, forms, local interaction, or optimistic state.
nodes.norm_label: server component reads and interactive mutation boundaries

nodes.label: Narrow privileged server-only operations
nodes.rationale: Use the admin client only where the caller RLS context cannot perform the operation; keep browser, server, and privileged clients separate and never expose service keys.

nodes.label: Durable coalesced Google Calendar reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Calendar writes enqueue a coalesced database job; a post-response worker accelerates execution and a protected scheduled drain supplies durability.

nodes.label: Domain route and ownership navigation
nodes.rationale: Projects own /projects, archive, and templates; Tasks own /my-tasks and project Board; Productivity owns /leaderboard and summaries; Calendar owns /calendar and integration APIs; Studio operations own team, contractors, office, and admin. Finance owns /finance, /finance/movements, /finance/expected, and /finance/categories through Finance queries/actions and src/lib/finance-fx.ts and src/lib/finance-planning.ts. Business trips belong to /finance/trips; project view=finance uses the shared Finance projects helpers.

nodes.label: Implementation and migration authority over documentation
nodes.rationale: Use ordered migrations for database behavior, current source for application behavior, focused tests for contracts, generated types for schema shape, and architecture docs for navigation. Repository state does not prove remote deployment.
nodes.norm_label: implementation and migration authority over documentation

nodes.label: auth.getUser and resolveActiveStudioMembership
nodes.rationale: getSession is not an authorization source; the membership resolver is canonical.

nodes.label: Typed input validation and reused domain types
nodes.rationale: Validate mutations, usually with Zod; avoid any, unsafe assertions, duplicate DTOs, and hand-edited generated database types.
nodes.norm_label: typed input validation and reused domain types

nodes.label: English and Ukrainian next-intl localization
nodes.rationale: Unprefixed routes resolve locale from studioflow-locale cookie, Accept-Language, then English.

nodes.label: Europe/Kyiv business time and date-only semantics
nodes.rationale: Preserve date-only project/task deadlines and full-day time off.
nodes.norm_label: europe/kyiv business time and date-only semantics

nodes.label: Dense quiet operational UI and accessible shared navigation
nodes.rationale: Use warm neutral surfaces, restrained hierarchy, borders before shadows, and semantic colors. Drawers/navigation remain labelled, focus-trapped, keyboard-operable, scroll-locked, safely dismissible, and restore focus.
nodes.norm_label: dense quiet operational ui and accessible shared navigation

nodes.label: Mutation revalidation across consumers
nodes.rationale: Project/task mutations commonly affect Projects, Dashboard, My Tasks, Calendar, and Leaderboard.

nodes.label: Whole-namespace client translation ownership
nodes.rationale: src/i18n/request.ts retains the full server dictionary. src/i18n/message-scopes.ts defines root, shell, and domain namespace ownership; DomainMessages delivers only owned domain namespaces.

nodes.label: ScopedIntlProvider inherited message merging
nodes.rationale: Merges additional client messages without reserializing ancestors; locale updates refresh root/domain messages, and normal RSC navigation delivers destination messages.

nodes.label: Static and dynamic import translation ownership contracts
nodes.rationale: Tests follow route imports and ancestor scopes, reject unreviewed dynamic namespaces/whole dictionaries, and preserve complete namespaces for optional and role-specific UI; they do not prune runtime keys.
nodes.norm_label: static and dynamic import translation ownership contracts

nodes.label: Deferred profile editor with eager OAuth return handling
nodes.rationale: profile-avatar-editor.tsx retains the persistent trigger, current avatar, and eager OAuth listener. profile-editor-dialog.tsx and crop/city/date/Google controls load on first opening, show a cancellable spinner, then stay mounted to preserve state and focus behavior.
nodes.norm_label: deferred profile editor with eager oauth return handling

nodes.label: Project Finance owning route and modules
nodes.rationale: Project view=finance uses Finance queries, actions and finance-projects helpers.
nodes.norm_label: project finance owning route and modules

nodes.label: finance_accounts
nodes.rationale: Each account represents an independent cash pool and currency pocket. Archived accounts remain historical cash and deletion is restricted. Account creation uses a request UUID rather than payload equality as identity, so separate requests may legitimately create identical accounts.

nodes.label: finance_project_totals
nodes.rationale: Exact database numeric totals are grouped by stream and currency and transported as decimal text. Collected uses effective allocations net of releases; planned is active remaining value not established as receivable; unscheduled contract value stays separate and opening cash is excluded.

nodes.label: Historical opening valuation
nodes.rationale: Nonzero foreign openings retain reporting amount, FX rate, source, effective date and actor/time on finance_accounts in studio cutover context, using exact reporting-currency rounding once.

nodes.label: Cutover FX resolution
nodes.rationale: An explicit Accounts action uses the movement historical FX resolver with the cutover date rather than today. Missing NBU rates save nothing and require retry or an explicit manual fallback. Same-currency openings use original amounts and zero foreign openings need no assumed rate.

nodes.label: Draft valuation invalidation
nodes.rationale: Changes to opening amount, account currency, reporting currency or cutover clear stale draft valuations; context checks under the Finance parent lock reject stale submissions.

nodes.label: Legacy finalized valuation completion
nodes.rationale: Older finalized setups permit absent valuations to be filled once without unlocking amounts, currencies or cutover. Completed valuation and provenance are immutable even against direct privileged edits.

nodes.label: Opening valuation accounting boundary
nodes.rationale: Opening valuation creates no ledger entries, expected items or cash activity; native balances keep original openings, historical consolidated cash uses frozen valuation and current balances and forecasts use report-date FX independently.

nodes.label: Studio-scoped cash planning
nodes.rationale: Finance is a separate administrator-only management domain; project lifecycle, CRM budgets, equipment costs, Calendar reminders and Leaderboard bonuses do not create Finance data.

nodes.label: Setup finalization
nodes.rationale: Explicit finalization requires an active account, valuation of every nonzero foreign opening including archived accounts, and cutover on or before today in Europe/Kyiv. It records actor/date and fixes reporting currency, cutover, account openings and completed valuation provenance. Future draft cutovers remain valid. Finalization cannot be undone through ordinary APIs; later accounts start at zero and archive/restore preserves history.

nodes.label: Opening balances
nodes.rationale: Opening cash is measured at the beginning of cutover and is neither a transaction nor revenue or expense.

nodes.label: Exact monetary arithmetic
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL validates currency precision and computes exact monetary amounts and valuation rounding. Report amounts remain decimal text through transport and native locale formatting; bounded native inputs retain existing domain types. Chart geometry alone may use JavaScript numbers within the safe minor-unit range.

nodes.label: Immutable cash ledger
nodes.rationale: Cash movements and signed entries are append-only; corrections require reasoned reversals rather than updates or deletes.

nodes.label: Transfer cash semantics
nodes.rationale: Transfer principal is not income or expense; source-account fees remain operating, while reporting FX differences stay transfers.

nodes.label: Historical reporting FX
nodes.rationale: Entries retain dated rate, source and rounded reporting amount; missing or mismatched NBU rates fail closed and require an explicit manual choice.

nodes.label: Actual refunds
nodes.rationale: Refunds link incoming/outgoing originals, use the same account and refund-date valuation, and cannot exceed unreversed principal.

nodes.label: Correction reversals
nodes.rationale: A reversal negates every original entry and valuation, including fees; originals permit only one reversal and refund history must be reversed first.

nodes.label: Studio settings lock
nodes.rationale: The shared studio parent lock serializes account creation, cash, matching and settings/finalization mutations. Movement posting order and snapshot capture order are allocated from a private monotonic sequence under this same lock. Immutable request auditing returns original results for identical UUID retries and rejects changed payloads, including concurrent submissions.

nodes.label: Category snapshots
nodes.rationale: Category direction and nature remain fixed; posted snapshots and legacy free text preserve historical classification through rename and archive.

nodes.label: Established outstanding
nodes.rationale: Explicit established status requires agreed fixed value and entitlement or obligation; future agreements alone do not establish receivables.

nodes.label: Expected settlement
nodes.rationale: Remaining and outstanding balances derive from immutable allocations; expected timing and contractual due date remain independent.

nodes.label: Unapplied attention
nodes.rationale: Broad historical payment availability supports matching; actionable attention is restricted to advances/prepayments or allocation history.

nodes.label: Settlement reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Refunds consume availability then release newest allocations; reversing a refund restores unapplied money without restoring old matches.

nodes.label: Strict Finance administrator boundary
nodes.rationale: Verified actor, active profile and exactly one active admin studio membership are required; SELECT-only grants, RLS and guarded RPCs enforce access.

nodes.label: Project agreement revisions
nodes.rationale: Immutable numbered terms and amendment reasons retain design and supervision history. Value-only revisions leave schedules unchanged; the explicit builder atomically revises unpaid items with new terms. Protected allocation history and actual receipts remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Project revenue context
nodes.rationale: Permanent project/source identities attach to shared expected items; collected totals use effective allocations, planned totals use active remaining amounts not established as receivable, and excess stays actionable credit. After allocation history, amount, currency, category, due date and certainty are locked even through the global RPC; expected timing, description and established status remain editable.

nodes.label: Unscheduled contract value
nodes.rationale: Unscheduled agreement value remains separately visible without an invented cash date. Cancelling unpaid expected value removes it from receivables and timed forecasts without amending the commercial agreement or its unscheduled remainder.

nodes.label: Supervision occurrences
nodes.rationale: Explicit monthly batches generate at most twelve months and preserve cancelled month identities. Per-visit charges retain permanent same-project Calendar visit identity and use terms effective on the visit Kyiv date, including historical revisions.

nodes.label: Payroll components
nodes.rationale: Net/gross agreement, employee payout, deductions/remittances and employer cost are separate; unknown costs remain null, and no statutory tax engine is implied.

nodes.label: Automatic schedule coverage
nodes.rationale: Rule saves maintain stable expected occurrences through twelve months; planning, forecast and administrator Calendar reads reconcile their supported horizon before reading.

nodes.label: Protected schedule projections
nodes.rationale: Future revisions update only unearned unallocated projections; past, established, partial, settled and manually cancelled items remain intact.

nodes.label: Payroll lifecycle stop
nodes.rationale: Removal/deactivation stops future service months and cancels untouched future projections while retaining history; restoration never restarts pay and a new schedule can reuse system-cancelled identities.

nodes.label: Amount-free payroll reminders
nodes.rationale: Calendar exposes only created payout/bonus dates to administrators; money never enters ordinary notifications, activity or Google projection.

nodes.label: Cash Budget
nodes.rationale: An immutable category/year revision holds twelve reporting-currency monthly values. Zero is explicit; missing is not zero. Budget is a comparison baseline and never creates cash.

nodes.label: Rolling Forecast
nodes.rationale: Full-period Forecast equals historical Actual plus unsettled Remaining. Agreed items enter Confirmed; Including planned adds tentative, including estimated values.

nodes.label: Forecast timing
nodes.rationale: Expected date takes priority over due date. Past outgoing timing rolls to today; stale incoming and undated values remain outside dated totals and require attention.

nodes.label: Planning actuals
nodes.rationale: Historical reporting amounts preserve signed refunds/reversals, exclude transfer principal and openings, include operating fees and retain unclassified legacy cash.

nodes.label: Flat forecast FX
nodes.rationale: Today's effective NBU rate or explicit manual overrides stay flat across the horizon; source and date persist, missing rates mark totals incomplete and actual ledger FX never changes.

nodes.label: Cash projection
nodes.rationale: All recorded account balances including archived accounts are revalued at forecast rates, then only remaining net cash is added to avoid duplicate actuals.

nodes.label: Coverage diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Unknown payroll costs, unreconciled schedule coverage, missing supervision months and unscheduled contracts mark known subtotals incomplete; diagnostics never invent cash or sales.

nodes.label: Immutable forecast snapshots
nodes.rationale: Snapshots preserve immutable expectations, source identities, dates, classification, monthly amounts, FX, budgets, coverage and valued cash baseline without copying actual ledger rows or category totals. Capture recalculates under the Finance lock and idempotent retries retain the original capture. Lists use capture order before legacy timestamps; old snapshots retain expectations but require a new capture for comparison.

nodes.label: Snapshot observation boundary
nodes.rationale: Comparison includes live historical actuals only when movement posting_order exceeds snapshot capture_order, allocated by a private monotonic sequence under the same studio lock. Transaction-start timestamps remain unchanged and never determine inclusion. Financial dates still run from capture day through the horizon, including later same-day payments; current-month comparison is partial. Backdated corrections can change observed actuals without changing saved expectations.

nodes.label: Database-side aggregation
nodes.rationale: Exact reporting scans execute in PostgreSQL so API row limits cannot silently truncate totals.

nodes.label: Management Overview
nodes.rationale: Finance home is the current-state control center: recorded cash, recent net flow, next-30-day outflow, overdue count, actionable attention, current-month operating flows and five upcoming payments. Planning owns configuration and detailed analysis.

nodes.label: Historical cash chart
nodes.rationale: History retains frozen original valuations; forecast starts separately at current assumed FX. Overview crops canonical daily closing points at upcomingThrough and carries the last exact balance to the window edge. Planning keeps the full series.

nodes.label: Daily forecast chart
nodes.rationale: Forecast starts at today's FX-valued cash and adds canonical dated remaining items. Low point includes starting cash and daily closes without inferring same-day ordering.

nodes.label: Accessible exact chart data
nodes.rationale: Exact report money stays decimal text and uses Finance catalog minor units through the shared formatter. SVG coordinates alone use JavaScript numbers, with unsafe catalog-precision minor units triggering the open exact data table and hidden flow bars; exact labels and normal-chart keyboard tooltips remain.

nodes.label: Actual flow comparison
nodes.rationale: Opening cash and transfer principal are excluded; fees, signed refunds/reversals, financing and owner distributions remain distinct. Net flow need not equal FX-valued cash change.

nodes.label: Overview receivables
nodes.rationale: Established agreed fixed outstanding amounts across all dates use shared FX assumptions, including currencies beyond the forecast horizon.

nodes.label: Upcoming cash
nodes.rationale: Canonical dated remaining items run through today plus thirty days capped at forecast end; contractual due date stays visible alongside revised expected timing.

nodes.label: Category Budget Forecast Actual
nodes.rationale: Canonical monthly comparisons aggregate over the selected horizon and sort by absolute variance. Budget and variance require every monthly baseline; drill-down preserves scenario, horizon and rates.

nodes.label: Overview attention
nodes.rationale: Three visible actionable rows plus a disclosure for remaining issues; grouped missing FX links to planning, opening valuation to Accounts, expected items by ID, payroll and schedule issues to compensation. Missing data never becomes zero.

nodes.label: Finance account administration
nodes.rationale: Draft studios see setup and account administration lives at /finance/accounts; /finance is the management Overview.

nodes.label: Finance
nodes.rationale: Studio-scoped administrator-only cash management domain; operational domains do not implicitly create Finance data.

nodes.label: Finance administrator boundary
nodes.rationale: Verified active profile, active administrator membership and exactly one active studio membership protect private financial data through RLS and guarded RPCs.

nodes.label: finance_categories
nodes.rationale: Active and future schedule category dependencies prevent archival, including implicit payroll employer-cost/remittance categories and unknown costs beyond the forecast horizon.

nodes.label: finance_expected_items
nodes.rationale: Ordinary expected items carry cash expectations independently from actual cash and settlement.

nodes.label: finance_schedules
nodes.rationale: Stable identities distinguish monthly employee payroll from recurring studio obligations.

nodes.label: finance_schedule_terms
nodes.rationale: Immutable numbered effective-dated revisions preserve agreed salary and recurring obligation history.

nodes.label: finance_obligations
nodes.rationale: Permanent employee/service-period/source identities prevent duplicate payroll occurrences across retries, revisions and cancellations.

nodes.label: finance_obligation_items
nodes.rationale: Components link permanent obligations to ordinary Finance expected items rather than introducing a separate settlement store.

nodes.label: Automatic occurrence maintenance
nodes.rationale: Maintains stable expected occurrences over supported planning horizons without implying earning or payment; protects established, allocated and completed occurrences.

nodes.label: Permanent payroll stop boundary
nodes.rationale: Team removal or deactivation stops old payroll from the next service month; restoration requires a replacement schedule rather than restarting old pay.

nodes.label: Payroll replacement ownership
nodes.rationale: A replacement adopts only unprotected system-cancelled occurrences with valid replacement terms and a stopped predecessor; the same obligation and component identities acquire explicit ownership, preventing predecessor cancellation regardless of processing order.

nodes.label: Unknown payroll cost completion
nodes.rationale: Originally unknown remittances and employer costs can be completed for past service months or earned/allocated payouts without changing salary terms, payouts or cash.

nodes.label: complete_finance_payroll_cost
nodes.rationale: Guarded reasoned versioned completion appends audit facts; positive amounts create or revise expected components, zero or unknown cancels unsettled components. Established components or allocation history prohibit further edits.

nodes.label: finance_payroll_cost_revisions
nodes.rationale: Stores explicit payroll completion facts and preserves their latest state through automatic maintenance and forecast diagnostics.

nodes.label: Planning request audit
nodes.rationale: Immutable finance_planning_requests auditing preserves submitted revisions and supports idempotent guarded writes. Account creation, project agreement saves, manual visit prices and payroll completion share this audit boundary.

nodes.label: Unknown payroll cost diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Null employer costs/remittances remain attention items even when payout is settled; latest explicit completion state determines diagnostics and unresolved issues leave known subtotals incomplete.

nodes.label: calculate_finance_forecast
nodes.rationale: Uses canonical remaining expected amounts and historical actuals; schedule rules remain diagnostics and never contribute duplicate cash.

nodes.label: finance_expected_balances
nodes.rationale: Canonical remaining amounts are shared by project, payroll and recurring expectations; gross salary is never added beside payout and remittances.

nodes.label: finance_allocations
nodes.rationale: Immutable signed matching history supports partial and many-to-many settlement without creating cash.

nodes.label: finance_payroll_calendar
nodes.rationale: Amount-free administrator-only reminder projection of payout and bonus expected dates; no financial data reaches ordinary notifications or Google projection.

nodes.label: cancel_finance_project_expectation
nodes.rationale: Guarded project cancellation requires a reason, item version and effective-settlement check under the studio lock; refunds alone never cancel expectations. Neither cancellation path changes cash and cancelled items cannot reopen.

nodes.label: Reasoned project cancellation
nodes.rationale: With no retained settlement, cancellation preserves original amount, terms, payment and allocation history. Cancelled originals retain visit/month billing identity; closed unpaid value leaves receivables and timed forecasts without changing the agreement total.

nodes.label: Retained settlement replacement
nodes.rationale: Explicit confirmation atomically releases retained matches, cancels the original and rematches the exact retained amount to a fully paid replacement in the same project, stream and currency. Releases and original-to-replacement audit are append-only; original billing identity and actual cash remain intact.

nodes.label: Historical Kyiv visit pricing
nodes.rationale: Existing non-cancelled same-project Calendar site visits select agreement revisions by the visit Kyiv date, including historical revisions. The form defaults amount and currency from those terms; contract-default saves verify the applicable revision and price again.

nodes.label: Explicit manual visit override
nodes.rationale: The explicit manual pricing override survives visit selection changes and preserves the applicable agreement link and request audit. Historical monthly-retainer extra visits require explicit extra-charge confirmation and deliberately entered amount and currency; unrelated current per-visit terms never seed them.

nodes.label: save_finance_account
nodes.rationale: Account creation requires a request UUID and uses the studio lock plus immutable planning audit. Identical retries return the original account ID while changed payloads conflict; existing-account edits retain their usual guards.

nodes.label: finance_planning_requests
nodes.rationale: The immutable request audit records account-create identity and payload so concurrent or lost-response retries recover the original account without replaying edits.

nodes.label: Account create request identity
nodes.rationale: A UUID survives the create form lifetime and is renewed for every new Add account flow. Identity belongs to the request rather than account field equality, permitting legitimately identical accounts under separate request IDs.

nodes.label: Account create retry recovery
nodes.rationale: Identical concurrent or lost-response retries recover the original account ID even after finalization, valuation, rename or archival; recovery never resets current account state. Changed payloads for the same request conflict.

nodes.label: Kyiv cutover finalization
nodes.rationale: Draft cutovers may be future dates, but finalization requires cutover on or before the Europe/Kyiv business date. A database trigger also guards direct finalized inserts and updates; the requested date is never silently changed.

nodes.label: Legacy future-finalized recovery
nodes.rationale: Preserve history when legacy future-finalized state exists and wait until cutover before using current-cash reports. An incorrectly recorded date needs a separately reviewed repair; ordinary setup APIs never unlock finalized history.

nodes.label: finance_movements.posting_order
nodes.rationale: Monotonic posting order distinguishes movements posted after a snapshot under the Finance lock. Pre-migration movements have order zero; unchanged transaction-start timestamps do not decide comparison inclusion.

nodes.label: snapshot.capture_order
nodes.rationale: Snapshot boundary uses a private monotonic sequence under the studio lock. Retries keep the original capture, and list ordering prioritizes capture order over legacy timestamps.

nodes.label: Private monotonic sequence
nodes.rationale: A shared private sequence allocates movement posting and snapshot capture order under the studio lock so transaction-start timestamps do not misclassify which cash postings followed capture.

nodes.label: Legacy snapshot comparison
nodes.rationale: Older snapshots retain saved expectations and original assumptions but have no reconstructible ordering boundary. Comparison explicitly requires a new capture instead of inventing historical order; pre-migration movements are assigned zero.

nodes.label: Decimal money rendering
nodes.rationale: Cards, drilldowns, planning and chart tables retain decimal text through native Intl.NumberFormat string formatting. The shared formatFinanceAmount selects Finance catalog minor units on every reporting surface, including numeric-only cards and chart tables, while preserving locale separators; Intl currency defaults never determine Finance precision.

nodes.label: Decimal text transport
nodes.rationale: Account balances, Project Finance aggregates, opening valuations and movement valuations are selected as decimal text before Data API JSON parsing to preserve exact values. Bounded native inputs retain their existing domain types.

nodes.label: Safe chart coordinates
nodes.rationale: Only SVG coordinates use JavaScript numbers. When minor units at the Finance catalog currency precision exceed the safe integer range, the plot becomes an open exact data table and flow bars disappear while exact labels remain. Normal charts preserve keyboard tooltips.

nodes.label: Intl.NumberFormat
nodes.rationale: Native decimal-string formatting preserves exact monetary values and locale separators. Finance catalog minor units, not Intl currency defaults, control precision through formatFinanceAmount.

nodes.label: formatFinanceAmount
nodes.rationale: Shared Finance amount formatting applies catalog monetary minor units throughout reporting, including numeric-only cards and chart tables, while preserving decimal text and locale separators.

nodes.label: Finance catalog precision
nodes.rationale: The Finance ISO 4217 reference catalog owns monetary precision consistently across database validation, reporting labels, numeric-only cards, chart tables and safe chart-coordinate bounds.

nodes.label: Historical retainer extra pricing
nodes.rationale: A historical monthly-retainer visit requires deliberate extra-charge amount and currency. Unrelated current per-visit terms must never seed that price; explicit manual values survive selection changes.

nodes.label: Project entitlement editing
nodes.rationale: A future project due date never automatically establishes entitlement in the form. Existing stored entitlement is preserved during edits because earned status is independent of dates and agreement value.

nodes.label: Recurring payment groups
nodes.rationale: Studio-persisted one-level organization independent of financial history. Cross-group checkbox or Ctrl/Cmd selection uses guarded per-rule assignments; completed moves persist and failures remain selected for safe retries.

nodes.label: Team payroll setup
nodes.rationale: Optional initial setup for active members without an unstopped agreement. Shared defaults and per-person overrides use the existing save RPC; stable per-row request IDs retain successful rows and permit safe retries without revising existing agreements.

nodes.label: Cash planning modes
nodes.rationale: Forecast is the default planning mode; Budget and Forecast history share the route. Planning reuses get_finance_overview and its embedded canonical forecast for summaries, cash chart, monthly detail and FX scope; Budget editing remains immutable revisions.

nodes.label: Project financial summary and payment presentation
nodes.description: Project value, collected, outstanding receivables and future planned payments remain separate; unscheduled value is actionable and next payment is independent of list filters and pagination.
nodes.norm_label: project financial summary and payment presentation

nodes.label: Project value and payment schedule builder
nodes.description: Fixed or area-times-rate pricing preserves immutable revision snapshots. Exact currency rounding reconciles templates against total less full protected scheduled value. Explicit unpaid redistribution, keep amounts, manual changes and unscheduled remainder use canonical expected items through an admin-only atomic idempotent RPC; NBU reference conversion never changes contract value.
nodes.norm_label: project value and payment schedule builder
nodes.community_name: Project value and payment schedule builder

nodes.label: Finance business-trip projection
nodes.rationale: Finalized Finance setup enables one-way, idempotent projection of real non-recurring business-trip events. Event/participant triggers synchronize operational metadata; setup finalization and migration backfill eligible events. Kyiv dates convert exclusive all-day ends into inclusive Finance ends. Reads create nothing, manual trips remain independent, and employee Calendar access grants no Finance access.

nodes.label: Calendar-owned trip metadata
nodes.rationale: calendar_source_id preserves immutable source identity; calendar_event_id is a same-studio live FK cleared on physical deletion. Calendar owns title, destination, inclusive Kyiv dates, note and active travelers. Finance rejects edits to linked operational metadata and retains explicit administrator-owned financial status. Project attribution locks after any financial entry.

nodes.label: Calendar trip source lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Calendar cancellation, type change or deletion marks source state. Empty linked trips cancel; trips with entries retain Finance status and obligations for explicit administrator reconciliation. Source identity, financial entries and removed-traveler history survive deletion and participant changes.

nodes.label: Current-FX trip plan estimates
nodes.rationale: Plan estimates use current resolveForecastAssumptions rates with exact reporting-currency rounding through the shared project reference-value helper. Native plan values remain immutable; new foreign plans require no account or historical FX valuation. fx_CODE manual assumptions share Forecast inputs. Missing rates make Plan and Variance incomplete rather than zero; actuals retain historical FX.

nodes.label: Multi-traveler per diem coverage
nodes.rationale: Per diem multiplies daily rate by inclusive eligible days and covered travelers. The form defaults to active travelers and supports a subset and eligible-day override. Database validation checks active same-trip identities, count, multiplication and currency precision. Immutable coverage survives participant changes and corrections copy it. Payer remains separate from covered travelers; legacy single-person calculations remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Immutable trip entry traveler coverage
nodes.rationale: Covered identities are receipt context separate from the payer. Tenant-safe entry/traveler foreign keys and immutable rows retain coverage across Calendar participant changes and personal expense reversals.

nodes.label: public.finance_trips
nodes.rationale: Durable calendar_source_id and a nullable same-studio calendar_event_id distinguish source identity from the live event. Uniqueness prevents duplicate projection; deleting the event clears only the live FK.

nodes.label: private.sync_calendar_finance_trip
nodes.rationale: Project and participant changes update operational context under the finalized studio Finance lock. Financial entries freeze project attribution and preserve Finance status during source lifecycle changes.

nodes.label: private.sync_calendar_finance_trip_trigger
nodes.rationale: Calendar event, participant, Finance-finalization and project-location triggers share one synchronizer; setup finalization backfills existing active business-trip events.

nodes.label: public.finance_trip_entries
nodes.rationale: traveler_count extends verified per-diem multiplication; nullable FX snapshots are allowed for plans only, while every actual still requires historical valuation.

nodes.label: public.finance_trip_entry_travelers
nodes.rationale: Immutable tenant-scoped entry/traveler references preserve per-diem coverage independently of payer and current active participation.

nodes.label: public.record_finance_trip_entry
nodes.rationale: Validates covered active travelers, appends exact per-diem counts and immutable coverage, copies coverage on reversal, and omits historical FX for foreign plans while reusing canonical cash and allocation RPCs.

nodes.label: public.save_finance_trip
nodes.rationale: Calendar-linked operational metadata and traveler selection are immutable through Finance; administrator financial status changes still reconcile balances.

nodes.label: public.finance_trip_totals
nodes.rationale: SQL totals preserve historical actuals but return null planned amount and variance when foreign plans require current read-time assumptions; native plan sums remain exact.

nodes.label: Trip expense sheet
nodes.rationale: Six persistent expense-type rows present native-currency Plan, Actual and Difference with secondary reporting equivalents. Plans edit inline, actuals start from their type row and expand into individual receipts. Payer totals and actionable traveler balances stay adjacent. Calendar linkage stays compact unless lifecycle or project attribution needs attention; metadata, advances and deliberate plan removal retain dialogs.

nodes.label: Inline trip entry editing
nodes.rationale: A single compatible unused plan is preselected, while multiple candidates require an explicit choice. Enter submits and Escape cancels without posting. Per-diem rate, currency and calculation remain inline; coverage/day overrides and optional cash timing use shared reduced-motion-aware disclosures.

nodes.label: Atomic append-only trip entry edits
nodes.rationale: One studio-locked idempotent transaction composes existing operations. Plans append correction and replacement with an automatic reason and protect allocated/consumed plans. Personal expenses require a reason and use receipt correction/reconciliation. Studio payments require confirmation and a reason, reverse original historical cash valuation, then record replacement; refunded/adjusted payments keep their specialist workflow. Failure rolls back the whole edit, preserving posted history.

nodes.label: Original actual retains plan baseline
nodes.rationale: Editing an actual does not consume its original plan again. The immutable original keeps the unique plan link and retired expectation; replacement planId is null, and the immutable request audit links original to replacement. Migration 20260922150100 supersedes the earlier replacement planId handling from 20260922150000.

nodes.label: public.edit_finance_trip_entry
nodes.rationale: Initial append-only edit RPC composes guarded request auditing, original receipt/cash reversal and replacement in one transaction. Its replacement preserves original.plan_id; this planId handling is superseded by migration 20260922150100 because the immutable original already owns the unique plan link.

nodes.label: public.edit_finance_trip_entry
nodes.rationale: Latest replacement preserves original receipt and unique plan attribution instead of consuming the plan twice. It overrides input planId with null; finance_planning_requests records original entry and result identity. This replaces migration 20260922150000 planId handling while retaining studio locking, request idempotency, required expense reasons, payment confirmation, correction/reversal guards and atomic rollback.
